in_sanskrit.name: Arko
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Sun, Light, Intelligence
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Arko एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। Arko is derived from the Sanskrit word ‘arka’, meaning the Sun. The name Arko is a symbol of light, wisdom, and strength. It is believed that those named Arko are endowed with the qualities of the Sun, including intelligence, strength, and courage.
